title: CHM Releases AlexNet Source Code
lineage: Museum curator recounts Krizhevsky extending his CUDA-written cuda-convnet for the ImageNet work, and CHM and Google releasing the historical source in 2025. The 2012 paper already offered GPU implementation code; no claim that all AlexNet code was first public in 2025.
